name: @pono/sdk
description: Typed client for the Pono service, generated from its OpenAPI document.

scripts.generate: uv run python ../../apps/api/scripts/export_openapi.py openapi.json && openapi-typescript openapi.json -o src/schema.d.ts
scripts.check: pnpm generate && git diff --exit-code -- openapi.json src/schema.d.ts
